line false.** It is a **symlink to the workspace store** (`../ai/f5sign-backend/CLAUDE.md`), so
correcting it is a commit **in the workspace repo, not this one** — the workspace's rule 4 forbids
crossing repos in one commit. Two coordinated changes, not one.

✅ **Both made, 2026-08-18**: backend `0abc68e`, workspace `c456a8b`. `CLAUDE.md` now carries

longer names it as out of scope. ⚑ **This line is the only place in *this* repository a reader can learn
whether that happened**, because the correction lives in a different git history — which is exactly why it
says *done* rather than staying phrased as owed work.
